# SPECIFICATION: REWARDS EARNING RULES DISPLAY

## CURRENT STATE SUMMARY

Currently, customers cannot see why they earned specific cashback rates on transactions. When customers contact support asking why they received 1% instead of 5% cashback, agents manually check transaction details against merchant lists, MCC codes, and monthly caps to explain the earning logic, generating 800+ monthly tickets. All reward calculation logic exists in the backend system but is not exposed to customers in the app.

---

## SCOPE

### IN SCOPE:
- Transaction-level cashback rate display with earning reason
- Accelerated rewards cap tracking and remaining balance visibility
- Exclusion category identification on transactions
- Standard vs accelerated earning rate differentiation
- Monthly cap consumption progress indicator
- Historical transaction earning breakdown view
- Reward reversal reason display for refunded transactions

### OUT OF SCOPE:
- Reward redemption flow modifications — redemption is DIY and working; this PRD addresses earning transparency only
- Changes to reward calculation engine logic — backend earning rules remain unchanged per existing SOP
- Predictive cashback estimates before transaction — requires real-time merchant classification not available pre-authorization
- Gamification or reward earning recommendations — focus is explanatory transparency, not behavioral nudges
- Negative reward balance auto-billing notifications — separate billing cycle feature, not earning display

---

## FUNCTIONAL USE CASES

### Use Case 1: View accelerated cashback earning with cap status
**Actor:** Primary user (PIXEL cardholder)

**Precondition:** User has completed at least one transaction that earned accelerated rewards (e.g., 5% on eligible merchant) and has active accelerated reward categories with monthly caps

**User Story:** As a PIXEL cardholder, I want to see why I earned 5% cashback on my Swiggy transaction and how much accelerated cashback I have remaining this month so that I can maximize my rewards before hitting the cap

**Steps:**
1. User opens PIXEL app and navigates to transaction history
2. User taps on a Swiggy transaction completed 2 days ago
3. System displays transaction detail screen with rewards earning breakdown section
4. User views "Cashback earned: ₹25 (5%)" with label "Accelerated - Food Delivery"
5. User sees progress bar showing "₹450 of ₹500 monthly cap used" with "₹50 remaining"
6. User taps "Why 5%?" info icon
7. System displays bottom sheet explaining: "This merchant qualifies for 5% accelerated cashback under Food Delivery category. Standard rate is 1%. Monthly cap: ₹500 cashback. Resets on 1st of each month."

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given user views transaction earning accelerated rewards, when transaction detail loads, then cashback amount displays with percentage, category label ("Accelerated - [Category Name]"), and distinguishing visual indicator (e.g., gold badge icon)
- Given user has consumed partial accelerated cap, when viewing accelerated transaction, then progress bar shows exact amount used (₹450), total cap (₹500), remaining amount (₹50), and reset date in format "Resets on [DD MMM]"
- Given user taps info icon on accelerated earning, when bottom sheet opens, then explanation includes: merchant qualification reason, standard rate comparison, monthly cap amount, current consumption, and reset schedule
- Given user has multiple accelerated categories, when viewing transaction, then only the applicable category for that specific transaction is displayed with its corresponding cap status
- Given accelerated cap was reached mid-month, when user views subsequent transaction at same merchant type, then system displays "Cashback earned: ₹5 (1%)" with label "Standard - Cap Reached" and message "Food Delivery accelerated cap of ₹500 reached on [DD MMM]. Earning standard rate until [reset date]"

**Failure State AC:**
- Given backend rewards service fails to return earning breakdown, when transaction detail loads, then user sees cashback amount with generic label "Cashback earned: ₹25" and message "Earning details temporarily unavailable. Your cashback is credited correctly." with retry option

**Priority:** P0

---

### Use Case 2: Understand zero cashback on excluded transaction
**Actor:** Primary user (PIXEL cardholder)

**Precondition:** User has completed a transaction on an excluded merchant category (e.g., fuel purchase, wallet load) that earned 0% cashback

**User Story:** As a PIXEL cardholder, I want to understand why my fuel purchase earned no cashback so that I know this is expected behavior and don't contact support

**Steps:**
1. User completes ₹2000 fuel transaction at HP petrol pump
2. User receives transaction notification showing ₹0 cashback
3. User opens app and navigates to this transaction in history
4. System displays transaction detail with rewards section showing "Cashback earned: ₹0"
5. User sees red exclusion badge with label "Excluded Category - Fuel"
6. User taps "Why ₹0?" info icon
7. System displays explanation: "Fuel purchases are excluded from cashback earning as per program terms. Excluded categories: Fuel, Wallet loads, Cash advances, EMI conversions."

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given transaction is on excluded MCC or merchant, when transaction detail loads, then rewards section displays "Cashback earned: ₹0" with red exclusion badge and category name (e.g., "Excluded Category - Fuel")
- Given user views excluded transaction, when info icon is tapped, then explanation lists: specific exclusion reason, complete list of all excluded categories (Fuel, Wallet loads, Cash advances, EMI conversions), and link to full terms
- Given transaction is wallet load to Paytm/PhonePe, when user views detail, then exclusion label reads "Excluded Category - Wallet Load" with explanation "Wallet loading transactions do not earn cashback"
- Given transaction is EMI conversion, when user views detail, then exclusion label reads "Excluded Category - EMI" with explanation "EMI transactions do not earn reward points as per program terms"

**Failure State AC:**
- Given merchant categorization is pending/unclear, when transaction detail loads within 24 hours of transaction, then system displays "Cashback calculation in progress" with estimated completion time "Cashback will be calculated within 24-48 hours of transaction settlement" instead of showing ₹0 prematurely

**Priority:** P0

---

### Use Case 3: View reward reversal reason after merchant refund
**Actor:** Primary user (PIXEL cardholder)

**Precondition:** User previously earned cashback on a purchase, merchant processed a refund, and system reversed the proportional reward points from user's account

**User Story:** As a PIXEL cardholder, I want to see why my reward balance decreased after a refund so that I understand the reversal is linked to the original transaction and is accurate

**Steps:**
1. User earned ₹50 cashback on ₹1000 Flipkart purchase on 15-Jan
2. Merchant processes full refund on 25-Jan
3. System reverses ₹50 cashback from user's reward balance on 26-Jan
4. User notices reward balance decreased and opens rewards history
5. User sees reversal entry: "-₹50 cashback" dated 26-Jan
6. User taps on reversal entry
7. System displays detail screen showing: "Cashback reversed: -₹50" with linked original transaction "Flipkart - ₹1000 (15-Jan-2025)" and reason "Merchant refund processed on 25-Jan-2025. Proportional cashback reversed."
8. User taps "View original transaction" link
9. System navigates to original Flipkart transaction showing refund status and cashback reversal linkage

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given merchant refund triggers cashback reversal, when user views rewards history, then reversal appears as separate line item with negative amount (-₹50), date of reversal, and label "Cashback Reversed - Refund"
- Given user taps on reversal entry, when detail screen loads, then system displays: reversed amount, original transaction details (merchant name, amount, date), refund processing date, reversal reason ("Merchant refund processed"), and clickable link to original transaction
- Given refund is partial (₹400 of ₹1000), when reversal detail loads, then system shows proportional calculation: "Original cashback: ₹50 on ₹1000. Refund: ₹400. Reversed: ₹20 (proportional to refund amount)"
- Given user navigates to original transaction from reversal link, when transaction detail loads, then rewards section shows updated net cashback: "Cashback earned: ₹50. Reversed: -₹20 (refund). Net: ₹30" with refund date and reversal date
- Given multiple refunds on same transaction, when user views original transaction, then all reversals are listed chronologically with individual amounts and dates

**Failure State AC:**
- Given reversal entry exists but original transaction link is broken (data inconsistency), when user taps "View original transaction", then system displays error message "Original transaction details unavailable. Reversal ID: [REV123456]. Contact support if you need clarification." with copy-to-clipboard option for reversal ID

**Priority:** P1

---

## NON-FUNCTIONAL USE CASES

### Performance Requirements:
- **Transaction detail load time with rewards breakdown**: Page must render complete rewards earning section within 800ms of user tap on transaction, including cashback amount, category label, and cap status
  - **Acceptance:** Measure p95 load time via instrumentation; 95% of transaction detail views must complete rewards section render in ≤800ms; test with 50 transactions in history

- **Rewards history list scroll performance**: Scrolling through 100+ reward entries (earnings + reversals) must maintain 60fps without frame drops or lag
  - **Acceptance:** Use Android Profiler / iOS Instruments to verify frame rate stays ≥58fps during rapid scroll through 200 reward entries; no ANR or UI thread blocking >16ms

### Security Requirements:
- **Rewards calculation logic obfuscation**: Earning rule details (MCC lists, merchant IDs, exact cap thresholds) displayed to user must not expose exploitable backend logic or allow reverse-engineering of merchant classification
  - **Acceptance:** Security review confirms displayed information is limited to: category names (generic), cap amounts (aggregate), earning rates (percentage only); no MCC codes, merchant IDs, or classification algorithms exposed in API responses or app code

### Accessibility Requirements:
- **Screen reader support for rewards breakdown**: All rewards earning information (cashback amount, category, cap status, exclusion reasons) must be accessible via TalkBack (Android) and VoiceOver (iOS) with logical reading order
  - **Acceptance:** Accessibility audit confirms: cashback amount announced with currency and percentage, category labels read with context ("Accelerated Food Delivery category"), progress bars announce "450 rupees of 500 rupees used, 50 rupees remaining", info icons have descriptive labels ("Learn why you earned 5 percent cashback")

- **Color-blind friendly visual indicators**: Accelerated vs standard vs excluded earning states must be distinguishable without relying solely on color (gold/green/red)
  - **Acceptance:** Design review with color-blindness simulator (Deuteranopia, Protanopia) confirms: accelerated uses gold badge + "Accelerated" text label, standard uses no badge + "Standard" label, excluded uses strikethrough + "Excluded" label; all states identifiable in grayscale

### Reliability Requirements:
- **Graceful degradation when rewards service unavailable**: If backend rewards breakdown API fails, transaction detail must still display basic cashback amount without breaking page load
  - **Acceptance:** Simulate rewards service 500 error; verify transaction detail loads successfully showing "Cashback earned: ₹25" with generic message "Detailed earning breakdown temporarily unavailable" and no app crash; user can still view transaction amount, merchant, date

- **Data consistency between transaction and rewards history**: Cashback amount shown on transaction detail must exactly match corresponding entry in rewards history; reversals must correctly link to original transactions
  - **Acceptance:** Automated test suite validates: for 100 sample transactions, cashback amount on transaction detail equals rewards history entry amount; for 20 refund scenarios, reversal entry links to correct original transaction ID; no orphaned reversals or mismatched amounts

---

## METRICS IMPACT

### Metric 1: Support ticket volume - Rewards earning queries
- **Current baseline:** 800 tickets/month (from problem statement)
- **Expected impact:** 60% reduction to ~320 tickets/month within 3 months post-launch; tickets should shift from "Why did I earn X%?" to edge cases like negative balance or system errors
- **Owner:** Customer Support Operations team

### Metric 2: Transaction detail page engagement rate
- **Current baseline:** Unknown — check with analytics team for current transaction detail view rate (% of users who tap into transaction details vs only viewing list)
- **Expected impact:** 25% increase in transaction detail views as users proactively check earning reasons; average time on transaction detail page increases from baseline by 15-20 seconds
- **Owner:** Product Analytics team

### Metric 3: Rewards redemption rate
- **Current baseline:** Unknown — check with rewards team for current monthly redemption rate (% of users with >₹100 balance who redeem)
- **Expected impact:** 10-15% increase in redemption rate as users gain confidence in earning transparency and understand cap optimization, leading to more engaged reward usage
- **Owner:** Rewards Product team

---

## NEW METRICS TO TRACK

### Metric 1: Rewards info icon tap rate
- **Definition:** (Number of users who tap "Why X%?" info icon on transaction detail) / (Number of users who view transaction detail with rewards section) × 100, measured daily
- **Target:** 30-40% tap rate in first month (indicates curiosity/confusion), declining to 15-20% by month 3 (indicates self-serve success)
- **Owner:** Product Analytics team

### Metric 2: Accelerated cap awareness rate
- **Definition:** (Number of users who view cap progress bar on accelerated transaction) / (Number of users with ≥1 accelerated transaction in month) × 100, measured monthly
- **Target:** 70% of users with accelerated transactions view cap status at least once per month
- **Owner:** Rewards Product team

### Metric 3: Exclusion explanation view rate
- **Definition:** (Number of users who tap info icon on excluded transaction) / (Number of users with ≥1 excluded transaction) × 100, measured monthly
- **Target:** 50% of users with excluded transactions view explanation (indicates proactive learning vs support contact)
- **Owner:** Product Analytics team

### Metric 4: Reversal detail view rate
- **Definition:** (Number of users who tap on reversal entry in rewards history) / (Number of users with ≥1 reversal in month) × 100, measured monthly
- **Target:** 60% of users with reversals view detail and linked original transaction (indicates self-serve understanding)
- **Owner:** Customer Support Operations team

---

## REPORTS & EXTRACTS IMPACT

### New reports needed:
- **Rewards Transparency Adoption Report (Weekly):** User engagement with rewards breakdown features — info icon taps, cap progress views, exclusion explanation views, reversal detail views; segmented by user tenure (<3 months, 3-6 months, >6 months) and transaction volume (low/medium/high spenders)
- **Earning Rule Confusion Heatmap (Monthly):** Aggregated view of which earning scenarios generate most info icon taps and longest time-on-page — identifies categories/rules needing clearer explanation copy
- **Support Ticket Deflection Report (Monthly):** Comparison of rewards-related support tickets pre/post launch; categorization of remaining tickets to identify gaps in self-serve explanations

### Existing reports affected:
- **Monthly Rewards Report (Opening balance, earning, burning, elapsed, closing balance):** Add new column for "Earning transparency views" — count of users who viewed detailed breakdown for their earnings that month
- **Customer Notifications Report:** Add tracking for users who viewed reversal details after receiving refund notification — measures notification-to-self-serve funnel effectiveness

### Reconciliation requirements:
- **Transaction-level cashback display vs backend calculation:** Daily reconciliation job to verify cashback amounts shown in app transaction details match amounts in core rewards ledger; flag discrepancies >₹1 for investigation
- **Cap consumption display vs actual cap tracking:** Real-time validation that cap progress bars shown to users reflect actual backend cap consumption; alert if displayed remaining amount differs from backend by >5%
- **Reversal linkage integrity:** Weekly audit to ensure all reversal entries in rewards history correctly link to original transaction IDs; flag orphaned reversals (no linked original transaction) for manual review

### Data extract requirements:
- **Customer Support team:** Daily extract of users who viewed exclusion explanations but still contacted support within 24 hours — indicates explanation copy needs improvement
- **Rewards Operations team:** Weekly extract of transactions where earning rate displayed
summary: Transaction-level cashback rate display with earning reason
Accelerated rewards cap tracking and remaining balance visibility
